<CAPTION>
A close-up portrait of an anthropomorphic animal with a bear-like face, featuring a white snout, dark brown shaggy fur, and a pink nose. The creature wears a dark gray knit beanie with two small, rounded ear-like protrusions on top and a small rectangular patch on the front displaying a white graphic. Its eyes are half-lidded with dark irises, and its mouth is slightly open, revealing teeth and a pink tongue. The fur appears messy and unkempt, with strands falling around the face. The background is a plain, muted gray, providing no contextual clues. The composition is centered on the head, with the camera angled slightly from the front. Lighting is soft and even, casting subtle shadows that define the facial features and texture of the fur. The patch on the beanie contains a white graphic that appears to be a stylized animal or symbol, but no readable text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A close-up portrait of an anthropomorphic animal with dark, messy hair, large pointed ears, and a pale gray face, wearing a dark blue beanie with a rectangular patch featuring a cross-like emblem. The creature has glowing pink eyes, a small pink nose, and a protruding tongue, with dark lines resembling tears or scars running down its cheeks. Its fur appears coarse and textured, with highlights of pink and cyan along the edges, suggesting a stylized, digital illustration. The background is a gradient of deep purple and magenta, creating a moody, neon-lit atmosphere. The composition is centered on the face, with the camera angled slightly upward, emphasizing the intense gaze. Lighting is dramatic, with strong contrast and neon outlines accentuating the subject’s features. A small signature, "Zane," is visible in the upper right corner of the beanie.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A white-furred anthropomorphic rodent with large, curved horns and a pair of goggles perched on its head, wearing a tattered, beige hooded cloak with a green gemstone brooch. Its face is expressive, with one eye closed in a smug grin, green glowing eyes, and a droplet of sweat on its cheek. The creature has a pink nose, sharp teeth, and a long, thin tail visible at the bottom right. Behind it, several shadowy figures with glowing green eyes and horned hoods lurk in the dark background. The setting is a starry night sky, with the main subject positioned slightly off-center, viewed from a medium close-up angle. The lighting is dramatic, with highlights on the creature’s face and cloak, casting deep shadows and emphasizing the glowing eyes and gemstone. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
This image is a character design sheet for a humanoid wolf-like figure, prominently featuring a muscular male character in a red hooded cloak with black tactical gear, including gloves, boots, and utility belts. The character has a wolf’s head with pointed ears, a snout, and a red cape that drapes over his shoulders. The design includes multiple views: a full-color front view, a black-and-white line art version, a back view, and smaller variations showing different expressions and poses. The background is a plain off-white surface with various annotations in Chinese characters and English text, including “ARKINCHT M4Z” in the top left, “HALLOWEEN” in a black box on the top right, and other labels like “ダンゾンフス” and “悪魔の懐抱” pointing to specific features. The composition is a collage of sketches and renderings, with the main subject centered and other views arranged around it. Lighting is flat and even, typical of concept art, highlighting textures like the fabric of the cloak and the metallic sheen of the gear. Visible text includes “明日方舟” in the top left, “ARKINCHT M4Z” with “©19MAJO” below it, and “HALLOWEEN” in bold black letters. The artist’s watermark “@Amzrgnoz” is at the bottom left.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized anthropomorphic canine figure sits hunched on the ground, its body rendered in a vivid gradient of magenta and cyan, with sharp, sketch-like lines defining its form. The creature has pointed ears, a snout, and a weary, downward gaze, with its arms wrapped around its knees. The background swirls in a vortex of deep blue and electric pink streaks, suggesting motion or a turbulent environment. The ground beneath the figure is textured with jagged, reddish-pink lines, enhancing the sense of chaos. The composition centers the figure slightly off-center, with the swirling background creating a dynamic, immersive frame. Lighting is dramatic and neon, casting glowing highlights on the figure’s limbs and torso while leaving deep shadows in the crevices of its form. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A young female anime character with long, flowing white hair streaked with gray, adorned with a black flower hairpin and a gold hairpin, is depicted in a close-up. She has large, expressive pink eyes with a slight sparkle, a small nose, and a slightly open mouth revealing a pink tongue. Her ears are cat-like, white with gray inner details, and she wears a black choker with white fur trim. Her outfit includes a black top with white fur accents and a white undergarment with gold trim. She is resting her chin on her hand, with her fingers near her mouth. The background is a dark, starry sky with a gradient of deep purple and black, suggesting a night scene. A golden tassel hangs from the top right corner. The lighting is soft and focused on her face, creating a gentle contrast with the darker background. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A fox-like humanoid with gray and white fur, pointed ears, and a bushy tail sits leaning against a tree trunk under a canopy of pink cherry blossoms. The figure wears a loose white garment with red sash-like straps and dark pants, holding a black flute to their lips as they play. The background is a soft gradient sky transitioning from peach to lavender, with falling petals and a few visible branches. The composition is a medium close-up, angled slightly from the side, capturing the subject from the waist up. Warm, golden light filters through the blossoms, casting a gentle glow on the figure and illuminating the petals in mid-air. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A white-furred anthropomorphic fox with golden markings and a crown-like headpiece is depicted in a reclining position, partially covered by fluffy white bedding. The character has long, flowing white hair, pointed ears, and a tail with bushy white fur. Their skin is pale and glossy, adorned with intricate golden patterns that resemble tribal or ornamental designs. The figure's body is curved, with visible curves and a prominent rear, and there are droplets of liquid on their skin and surrounding area. Dark, clawed hands with golden symbols are interacting with the character’s body. The background consists of soft, white, textured bedding and dark, shadowy elements that contrast with the bright white fur. The composition is a close-up, angled slightly from above, emphasizing the character’s form and the tactile details of the fur and skin. Lighting is dramatic, with highlights on the glossy skin and fur, casting deep shadows that enhance the contours and textures. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A close-up portrait of an anthropomorphic fox-like creature with a white face and fur, featuring sharp, dark eyebrows, long black eyelashes, and intense orange eyes with black pupils. The creature has a prominent black nose with small white speckles and a slightly downturned mouth. Its hair is styled in a spiky, vibrant purple mohawk, with white and black-tipped ears visible on either side of its head. The background is a solid, saturated red with subtle darker red splotches. The composition is centered on the face, shot from a straight-on angle, with soft, even lighting that highlights the texture of the fur and the glossy sheen on the eyes and nose. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A light blue, cartoon-style fox-like creature with large, expressive eyes and a small, orange tongue sticking out, wearing a brown cowboy hat with a small emblem on the band. The creature has pointed ears, a fluffy tail with white tips, and is depicted with a slightly smug or confident expression, one hand raised near its face. The background features a vast, open landscape with rolling hills, sparse vegetation, and distant mountains under a bright blue sky with scattered clouds and a setting or rising sun casting warm light. The foreground includes a few blades of grass at the bottom. The composition is centered on the creature, viewed from a slightly low angle, emphasizing its presence against the expansive backdrop. The lighting is warm and golden, suggesting late afternoon or early morning, with soft shadows enhancing the depth of the scene. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A cartoon-style white cat with large pointed ears, pink inner ear coloring, and a fluffy tail is perched atop a rugged mountain peak. The cat has a cheerful expression with half-closed eyes, a small pink nose, and a smiling mouth showing a pink tongue. Its paws are visible gripping the edge of the cliff. The mountain is detailed with vertical rock faces, patches of green vegetation, and dark pine trees clinging to its slopes. The background features a clear blue sky with scattered white clouds and a distant horizon line suggesting a vast landscape. The composition is centered on the cat, with the camera angle looking slightly upward to emphasize its position on the peak. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows that define the textures of the rock and the cat’s fur. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized, anthropomorphic white cat with large, expressive black eyes and a small, curved smile is the central focus. Its fur is predominantly white with light brown or tan accents on the inner ears, around the eyes, and on the tips of its paws and tail. The cat raises its right hand, index finger pointing upward, as if making a point or giving a warning. The background consists of a brownish-gray field adorned with scattered, stylized golden-brown leaves and branches, creating a naturalistic yet decorative setting. The composition is a close-up, centered on the cat’s upper body and face, with the camera angle straight-on, emphasizing its facial expression. The lighting is soft and even, casting gentle shadows that define the cat’s form without harsh contrasts. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A female anthropomorphic fox with long, flowing orange hair and pointed ears sits on a wooden surface, her body angled slightly toward the viewer. She has bright blue eyes and a gentle smile, with a fluffy white-tipped tail curled behind her. She wears a red hooded jacket over a dark brown crop top that reveals her midriff and toned abdomen, paired with dark shorts and thigh-high black stockings. Her right hand holds a small yellow object, possibly a bow, while her left hand rests on the wooden surface. The background is plain white, emphasizing the subject. The composition is a medium close-up, capturing her from the thighs up, with soft, even lighting that highlights the textures of her fur, clothing, and skin. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
Two anthropomorphic fox characters are depicted in a close embrace against a bright blue sky with soft white clouds. The foreground character, with vibrant orange hair and large fox ears adorned with black rings, wears a dark blue crop top, black thigh-high stockings, and a black and white striped skirt. Her expression is cheerful, with wide blue eyes and a smiling mouth. She has a fluffy orange tail and is kneeling on a wooden surface. The second character, partially obscured, has long blonde hair tied in a braid and is wearing a light-colored top. The background suggests an outdoor setting with a clear sky and a hint of a horizon. The composition is centered on the two figures, with the camera positioned at a slightly low angle to emphasize their closeness. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows and highlighting the smooth textures of their skin and clothing. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A large, stylized whale dominates the center of the image, rendered in layered, paper-cut style with a gradient of dark gray to light gray, featuring visible white stripes along its body and a series of small, round, metallic-looking protrusions along its side. The whale’s body curves gracefully, with its tail fin sweeping downward and its head angled upward. Behind the whale, a large, layered celestial body resembling a planet or moon displays a vibrant gradient from orange to yellow, with textured, cut-out cloud formations in gray and white layered across its surface. The background is a dark, starry space filled with various planets of different sizes and colors, including orange, blue, and brown, along with scattered stars and small, stylized clouds. The composition is vertical, with the whale positioned centrally, and the camera angle appears to be a direct frontal view slightly tilted upward. The lighting is dramatic, with warm hues emanating from the planet behind the whale, casting a soft glow on its body and creating a contrast with the dark, star-filled background. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A dark-furred anthropomorphic wolf with white hair and glowing amber eyes is depicted in a rain-soaked scene, wearing a black hooded jacket with yellow drawstrings and a large yellow emblem on the sleeve. The jacket is wet and glossy, with water droplets clinging to its surface and dripping down. The wolf’s face is partially obscured by the hood, revealing sharp teeth and a determined expression. The background consists of a gray, overcast sky with heavy rain streaking vertically, and dark, tangled branches or wires frame the top of the image. The composition is a close-up, focusing on the upper body and head of the wolf, with the camera angled slightly upward. The lighting is dim and moody, emphasizing the wet textures and the contrast between the dark jacket and the bright yellow accents. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized, digitally rendered animal head, resembling a fox or wolf, dominates the frame against a solid black background. The creature’s fur is a vibrant cyan-blue with sharp, angular highlights and darker shading that suggest a glossy, almost synthetic texture. Its large, pointed ears are similarly colored but feature red and white glitch-like distortions along their edges. The eyes are glowing red orbs with black pupils, conveying an intense, unnatural stare. The muzzle is pale pink, with a small nose and bared teeth dripping red liquid that cascades down the chin. The face is framed by short, spiky cyan hair, and faint whiskers extend from the cheeks. The entire image is overlaid with digital artifacts — jagged red and cyan lines that cut across the face, creating a glitch effect. The composition is a tight close-up, centered on the head, with no discernible camera angle beyond the direct frontal view. Lighting is high-contrast, with bright highlights on the fur and eyes against the deep black backdrop, enhancing the surreal, cyberpunk aesthetic. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A figure with white, spiky hair is shown from a high-angle perspective, partially submerged in dark blue water. The person’s right arm is extended forward, with the hand open and fingers splayed, while their left arm is bent at the elbow. They wear a dark green jacket and dark pants, and their hair is illuminated by a bright, almost glowing light that contrasts sharply with the surrounding darkness. The water around them churns with white foam and splashes, indicating movement. The background consists of deep, textured water with visible ripples and waves. The lighting is dramatic, with the main illumination focused on the figure’s hair and upper body, casting the rest of the scene into shadow. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A pink-furred anthropomorphic feline with white facial markings and yellow eyes is depicted in a close-up, wearing a tan trench coat with dark cuffs. The creature’s right hand is raised prominently toward the viewer, displaying a middle finger with a black nail, while its left hand is partially visible behind its head. The fur appears smooth with subtle shading, and the face has a stern, defiant expression with one eye narrowed. The background is dark and abstract, with splatters of black and hints of gold, suggesting a gritty or chaotic environment. The composition is tightly framed, focusing on the upper body and face, with the camera angled slightly from below to emphasize the gesture. Lighting is dramatic, casting shadows that accentuate the contours of the face and hand, while the pink fur glows slightly against the dark backdrop. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A large, inflatable toy shaped like a leopard’s paws and tail is prominently displayed on a sandy beach. The toy’s paws are oversized, with glossy black pads and cream-colored soles, outlined in yellow with black spots mimicking a leopard’s pattern. The tail, also inflatable, features alternating black and yellow stripes and lies curled in front. The toy’s head, partially visible, has a yellow face with black spots and a small red bow on top. The background reveals a tropical beach scene with turquoise ocean water, a palm tree, and a rocky shoreline under a bright blue sky with scattered white clouds. The camera angle is low, looking up at the toy, emphasizing its scale. Bright sunlight illuminates the scene, casting sharp reflections on the glossy surfaces of the toy. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A large, anthropomorphic tiger-like creature with orange and black striped fur, wearing a white cap with a green "L" logo, a black and yellow vest over a white shirt, white pants with black straps, and clawed gloves, stands confidently with arms crossed. Beside it, a smaller, similarly styled fox-like creature in a matching white cap and outfit holds a Poké Ball, smiling with clenched fists. Both have sharp claws and bushy tails. The background is plain white, emphasizing the characters. The composition is a full-body shot from a slightly low angle, highlighting their muscular forms. Lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows beneath their feet. The green "L" logo is visible on both caps, and the Poké Ball has a red and white design with a silver top.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A chibi-style anthropomorphic fox character stands against a plain white background, depicted in a full-body view with a slightly low-angle perspective. The character has orange fur with black spots on its legs and tail, large expressive blue eyes, and black-tipped ears that flop forward. It wears a white short-sleeved t-shirt with a small blue emblem on the chest and orange underwear with white trim. The fox’s right hand is raised to its face, wiping away a tear, while its left hand rests on its hip. Its tail, fluffy and bushy with black spots, curls behind it. The character’s expression is one of sadness or distress, with visible tears and a slightly downturned mouth. The lighting is even and bright, casting a soft shadow beneath the character’s feet. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A gray anthropomorphic wolf with pointed ears and a black headband is depicted mid-air, falling or leaping with arms outstretched and legs bent. The wolf wears a white shirt with orange trim, black pants with orange stripes, and black-and-white sneakers. Its face is expressive, with wide eyes and an open mouth showing teeth, suggesting surprise or exertion. Around its neck is a brown beaded necklace, and its wrists are adorned with black bracers featuring gold studs. The background is a bright blue sky with fluffy white clouds and a large, glowing sun positioned above and slightly to the left. Thin white streaks, possibly indicating motion or falling debris, are visible near the wolf’s legs. The composition is dynamic, with the wolf angled diagonally across the frame, viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The lighting is bright and even, casting soft highlights on the wolf’s fur and clothing, enhancing the vividness of the colors. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A humanoid feline creature with long, flowing white hair and spotted fur is depicted emerging from a large, curling ocean wave. The creature has a fox-like face with pointed ears, dark eyes, and a slight smile, wearing a black bikini top with straps and a choker with a metallic clasp. The hair is voluminous and windswept, blending with the water as it arcs upward. The background shows a sunlit sky with soft clouds and the sun’s rays breaking through, casting a warm glow over the scene. The water is a deep teal with white foam and bubbles, suggesting motion and depth. The composition is centered on the creature’s face, with the wave curving around her, and the camera angle is slightly low, looking up at her. The lighting is bright and natural, with highlights on the hair and water surface, creating a dynamic and vivid atmosphere. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A cheetah-like humanoid figure is depicted in a dynamic, crouching pose, facing forward with an intense gaze. The creature has a tan coat with dark brown spots, a bushy mane of golden-brown fur, and small, rounded ears with pink interiors. It wears a black headband with a metallic plate featuring a circular emblem, a red draped cloth over its shoulders, and black wristbands with metallic accents. Its tail, long and spotted, curls upward behind it. The figure’s muscular physique is detailed with visible definition, and its paws are partially visible as it grips the ground. The background is a plain, light gray surface with soft shadows beneath the figure, suggesting a neutral studio-like setting. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of the fur, fabric, and metallic elements. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A young anthropomorphic cat with brown, spiky hair and large, pointed ears stands in a three-quarter profile, facing slightly to the left. The character has golden-yellow eyes with black pupils, a small nose, and a faint blush on their cheeks. Their body is slender and feline, covered in smooth, light-brown fur with darker brown patches on the tail and ears. The tail curves around the back, ending in a dark brown tip. The character’s arms are down by their sides, with one hand slightly curled. The background is a plain, light beige color, offering no additional context or objects. The composition is centered on the character, with a straight-on perspective that captures their full height. The lighting is soft and even, casting gentle shadows along the contours of the body and fur, enhancing the three-dimensional form without harsh contrasts. No text or markings are visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A pink, humanoid dragon with spiky, wing-like appendages and a long, scaled tail is perched atop a weathered tree stump. Its skin is smooth and glossy, with a gradient of pink hues, and it has sharp claws and a wide, open mouth showing teeth. The dragon’s arms are raised in a triumphant or celebratory pose, with water droplets visible around its body, suggesting it may have just emerged from water or is wet. The background features a bright blue sky with a few wispy clouds and distant mountain ranges covered in dense evergreen forests. The camera angle is low, looking up at the dragon, emphasizing its imposing stature. The lighting is bright and natural, casting soft shadows and highlighting the dragon’s wet, reflective skin. In the bottom right corner, there is a watermark that reads “@MirzitursAr”.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A muscular, reptilian humanoid with red and black scaly skin and a snarling, bird-like face is crouched in a combat stance, gripping a black assault rifle with a scope. The creature’s body is detailed with textured scales, visible muscle definition, and red splatters resembling blood or paint across its torso and arms. It wears dark tactical gear, including gloves and a belt. The background depicts a stylized forest with blue and white trees and snowy ground, contrasted by bold red paint splashes that streak across the scene. The composition is a close-up, angled slightly from below, emphasizing the creature’s aggressive posture. Lighting is dramatic, with high contrast and shadows accentuating the figure’s form against the bright, stylized backdrop. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A glossy black humanoid figure with cat-like features, including pointed ears and a small tail, lies supine on a black, segmented, padded surface. The figure’s skin is highly reflective, resembling polished plastic or latex, with visible seams and contours that follow its form. Its arms are raised with hands clenched into fists, and its legs are spread apart, with straps securing its wrists and ankles to the surface. The background is a plain white wall, with sunlight casting distinct shadows and highlights across the figure’s body and the surface beneath it. The camera is positioned directly above, capturing the scene from a top-down perspective. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A pair of transparent, glossy, clawed boots rests on a dark, draped fabric surface. The boots are made of a smooth, reflective material that resembles clear plastic or glass, with a slight blue tint visible at the soles and around the clawed toes. Each boot has five prominent, curved claws protruding from the toes, and the upper part extends to mid-calf with a slightly wrinkled texture near the ankle. The background is a solid black fabric with soft folds, creating a stark contrast that highlights the boots’ transparency and reflective surfaces. The camera is positioned at a low angle, capturing the boots from the front and slightly above, emphasizing their form and the way light reflects off their surfaces. Lighting is directional, casting bright highlights on the upper parts of the boots and creating soft shadows beneath them, enhancing their three-dimensional appearance. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized anthropomorphic wolf with light blue and white fur, sharp pointed ears, and amber eyes is depicted in a dynamic, crouching pose. The wolf has a snarling expression with bared teeth and wears a dark, open jacket with white fur trim on the collar and cuffs, revealing a white t-shirt underneath that features a yellow paw print design. Around its neck is a black collar with a blue pendant. The character’s lower body is clad in dark pants with a white belt and buckle, and its paws are clawed with black nails. A long, bushy tail with blue and white fur flows behind it. The background is a plain, neutral gray, emphasizing the subject. The composition is centered on the wolf, viewed from a slightly low angle that accentuates its aggressive stance. Lighting is even and soft, casting subtle shadows that define the form without harsh contrasts. No visible text is present.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A chibi-style anthropomorphic cat character with white spiky hair, gray ears, and a gray face, wearing a white shirt with a blue square patch on the left chest and black pants. The character has yellow eyes, a small pink X-shaped mark on the nose, and a simple smile. The background is a plain white with a light blue rectangular shape behind the character, suggesting a flat, stylized environment. The composition is centered with the character facing forward, viewed from a straight-on perspective. The lighting is even and bright, casting a soft shadow beneath the character, giving a clean, illustrated look. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A white-furred anthropomorphic female with long white hair, pointed ears, and red eyes is depicted in a seated position against a stone wall. She wears a black mask covering her nose and mouth, a black scale-like bra, and black leather straps and boots. Her tail is visible, and she is bound by chains around her wrists and waist. Two skulls lie on the ground near her feet. The background consists of dark gray stone blocks with hanging chains and a barred window allowing some light. The composition is a medium close-up, angled slightly from the side, with dramatic lighting casting shadows and highlighting her form. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A young anthropomorphic cat with brown fur, large expressive eyes, and a bushy tail is depicted in a dynamic, slightly hunched pose, one hand gripping the top of his head while the other rests on his thigh. He wears a white basketball jersey with yellow trim and the word "HONMARI" in bold yellow letters above the number "5" in blue. His shorts are white with yellow and black trim, and he has on white sneakers with black accents. A navy blue jacket is draped over his shoulders. Sweat droplets are visible on his skin, suggesting exertion or heat. The background is plain white, emphasizing the subject. The composition is a close-up, angled slightly from the side, capturing the character’s upper body and legs. Lighting is bright and even, highlighting the textures of his skin, the fabric of his clothing, and the glossy sheen of sweat. The text on the jersey reads "HONMARI" in uppercase letters, followed by the number "5" in a bold font.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A wolf-like humanoid with white fur, sharp claws, and blue eyes is depicted in a dynamic, crouching pose, gripping a large sword with both hands. The creature wears segmented armor in shades of gray and black, with metallic sheen and dark mesh panels on the torso and thighs. Its fur is thick and fluffy, especially around the neck and tail, which trails behind. The background consists of shattered stone and architectural ruins, with warm orange and brown tones suggesting fire or bloodstains on the debris. The composition is a medium close-up, angled slightly from the side, emphasizing the creature’s muscular form and aggressive stance. Lighting is dramatic, with strong highlights on the armor and fur, casting deep shadows that accentuate the scene’s intensity. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A muscular anthropomorphic tiger stands in a dynamic pose, arms raised with claws extended, showcasing a powerful physique. His fur is primarily white with bold purple stripes, and he has a long, striped tail that curves behind him. His face features sharp, angular features with yellow eyes and a snarling expression. He wears black and gold armored gear on his legs and arms, with brown leather straps and buckles. His torso is bare, revealing defined muscles and a small black tattoo on his chest. The background is a muted, shadowy environment with soft, diffused lighting casting dramatic highlights and shadows across his form. The composition centers him with a slight low-angle perspective, emphasizing his imposing stature. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
An anthropomorphic wolf-like character with dark gray fur, pointed ears, and bright blue eyes is depicted kneeling on one knee. The character has a muscular, bare torso with defined abs and a visible navel, and is wearing a partially open blue and white traditional-style robe with wave patterns along the edges. The robe is draped over the shoulders and hangs open, revealing the torso and lower body. The character’s lower body is clad in dark gray pants, and a white loincloth is visible around the waist and hips. The character’s hands are raised with fingers curled, and the nails are long and dark. The face shows an expression of surprise or excitement, with slightly parted lips and visible teeth. The background is plain white, emphasizing the subject. The composition is centered with the character facing forward, and the camera angle is straight-on. The lighting is even and bright, casting soft shadows that define the contours of the body. No text is visible in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A stylized anthropomorphic fox character with dark purple fur, white facial markings, and blue eyes is depicted in a kneeling position. The character has pointed ears, a bushy tail, and sharp claws, with a muscular torso partially covered by a light blue and white traditional robe with scalloped patterns. The robe is draped over the shoulders and hangs loosely, revealing the character’s chest and abdomen. The character’s expression is playful, with a slight grin and one hand raised near the head. The background is plain white, emphasizing the subject. The composition is centered with a frontal view, and the lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows. There is no visible text in the image.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A humanoid figure with fox-like features, including pointed ears and a bushy tail, stands in a dynamic pose. The character has greenish-yellow fur, glowing green eyes, and wears layered, patterned clothing in teal, brown, and white, with fringed edges and a belt featuring an eye-like emblem. They hold a sword in their right hand and gesture outward with their left, which has green markings. The background is abstract, with soft, watercolor-like splashes of pink, orange, and brown, suggesting falling leaves or petals. The ground is textured with brushstrokes of earth tones and sparse vegetation. The composition is centered on the figure, viewed from a slightly low angle, with soft, diffused lighting that highlights the character’s form and the vibrant colors of their attire. No text is visible.
</CAPTION>

<CAPTION>
A black cat with bright yellow eyes is partially submerged in water, its head and curved tail visible above the surface. The cat’s silhouette is solid black with no fur texture, and its eyes are simple, circular yellow dots.
